_about: Controls that WRITE to an account, matched on the element a tap will actually hit.
A rule matches when its `rid` regex full-matches the element's resource-id or anchor
(if given) AND its `label` regex is found in the lowercased text or content-desc (if given).
`action` = a ledger action (datacollect/scripts/ledger.py BUDGET): allowed only when the
operator enabled that write for the run AND budget_for(account, action) has room.
`forbidden` = no ledger action exists for it, so it is refused (doctrine: no likes,
comments, DMs, reposts, saves, reports from collection accounts). An operator can allow
a specific forbidden rule id for a run; nothing else can.
App rules are checked before `any_app` rules. First match wins.
`counted` (per app) = taps that open a budgeted READ; policy/reads.py counts them in the ledger.
`composers` = boxes where typing is a send (comment, DM, reply); text entry there is refused.
